source.how: Each question was answered by a separate fresh Claude Code subagent (Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-11-06) that saw only the system prompt and that one question; no API call, no gold answers, no tools beyond reading its prompt file. Replies are recorded verbatim.

summary.system_prompt:
You translate English questions into SQLite queries for the database below.

CONTRACT:
- Reply with exactly one SQLite SELECT statement (it may start with WITH) and nothing else:
  no markdown, no code fences, no comments, no explanation.
- Use only the tables and columns in the schema.
- If the question cannot be answered from this schema, reply with exactly: CANNOT_ANSWER

SCHEMA:
CREATE TABLE [Album]
(
    [AlbumId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [Title] NVARCHAR(160)  NOT NULL,
    [ArtistId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Album] PRIMARY KEY  ([AlbumId]),
    FOREIGN KEY ([ArtistId]) REFERENCES [Artist] ([ArtistId]) 
		ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION
)

CREATE TABLE [Artist]
(
    [ArtistId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [Name] NVARCHAR(120),
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Artist] PRIMARY KEY  ([ArtistId])
)

CREATE TABLE [Customer]
(
    [CustomerId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [FirstName] NVARCHAR(40)  NOT NULL,
    [LastName] NVARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    [Company] NVARCHAR(80),
    [Address] NVARCHAR(70),
    [City] NVARCHAR(40),
    [State] NVARCHAR(40),
    [Country] NVARCHAR(40),
    [PostalCode] NVARCHAR(10),
    [Phone] NVARCHAR(24),
    [Fax] NVARCHAR(24),
    [Email] NVARCHAR(60)  NOT NULL,
    [SupportRepId] INTEGER,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Customer] PRIMARY KEY  ([CustomerId]),
    FOREIGN KEY ([SupportRepId]) REFERENCES [Employee] ([EmployeeId]) 
		ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION
)

CREATE TABLE [Employee]
(
    [EmployeeId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [LastName] NVARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    [FirstName] NVARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    [Title] NVARCHAR(30),
    [ReportsTo] INTEGER,
    [BirthDate] DATETIME,
    [HireDate] DATETIME,
    [Address] NVARCHAR(70),
    [City] NVARCHAR(40),
    [State] NVARCHAR(40),
    [Country] NVARCHAR(40),
    [PostalCode] NVARCHAR(10),
    [Phone] NVARCHAR(24),
    [Fax] NVARCHAR(24),
    [Email] NVARCHAR(60),
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Employee] PRIMARY KEY  ([EmployeeId]),
    FOREIGN KEY ([ReportsTo]) REFERENCES [Employee] ([EmployeeId]) 
		ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION
)

CREATE TABLE [Genre]
(
    [GenreId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [Name] NVARCHAR(120),
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Genre] PRIMARY KEY  ([GenreId])
)

CREATE TABLE [Invoice]
(
    [InvoiceId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [CustomerId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [InvoiceDate] DATETIME  NOT NULL,
    [BillingAddress] NVARCHAR(70),
    [BillingCity] NVARCHAR(40),
    [BillingState] NVARCHAR(40),
    [BillingCountry] NVARCHAR(40),
    [BillingPostalCode] NVARCHAR(10),
    [Total] NUMERIC(10,2)  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Invoice] PRIMARY KEY  ([InvoiceId]),
    FOREIGN KEY ([CustomerId]) REFERENCES [Customer] ([CustomerId]) 
		ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION
)

CREATE TABLE [InvoiceLine]
(
    [InvoiceLineId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [InvoiceId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [TrackId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [UnitPrice] NUMERIC(10,2)  NOT NULL,
    [Quantity] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_InvoiceLine] PRIMARY KEY  ([InvoiceLineId]),
    FOREIGN KEY ([InvoiceId]) REFERENCES [Invoice] ([InvoiceId]) 
		ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
    FOREIGN KEY ([TrackId]) REFERENCES [Track] ([TrackId]) 
		ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION
)

CREATE TABLE [MediaType]
(
    [MediaTypeId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [Name] NVARCHAR(120),
    CONSTRAINT [PK_MediaType] PRIMARY KEY  ([MediaTypeId])
)

CREATE TABLE [Playlist]
(
    [PlaylistId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [Name] NVARCHAR(120),
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Playlist] PRIMARY KEY  ([PlaylistId])
)

CREATE TABLE [PlaylistTrack]
(
    [PlaylistId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [TrackId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_PlaylistTrack] PRIMARY KEY  ([PlaylistId], [TrackId]),
    FOREIGN KEY ([PlaylistId]) REFERENCES [Playlist] ([PlaylistId]) 
		ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
    FOREIGN KEY ([TrackId]) REFERENCES [Track] ([TrackId]) 
		ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION
)

CREATE TABLE [Track]
(
    [TrackId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [Name] NVARCHAR(200)  NOT NULL,
    [AlbumId] INTEGER,
    [MediaTypeId] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [GenreId] INTEGER,
    [Composer] NVARCHAR(220),
    [Milliseconds] INTEGER  NOT NULL,
    [Bytes] INTEGER,
    [UnitPrice] NUMERIC(10,2)  NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Track] PRIMARY KEY  ([TrackId]),
    FOREIGN KEY ([AlbumId]) REFERENCES [Album] ([AlbumId]) 
		ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
    FOREIGN KEY ([GenreId]) REFERENCES [Genre] ([GenreId]) 
		ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION,
    FOREIGN KEY ([MediaTypeId]) REFERENCES [MediaType] ([MediaTypeId]) 
		ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION
)

results.question: How many artists are there?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist;
results.reply: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist
results.model_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist

results.question: How many tracks are in the Rock genre?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock';
results.reply: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'
results.model_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

results.question: List the titles of all albums by AC/DC.
results.gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC';
results.reply: SELECT Album.Title FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC'
results.model_sql: SELECT Album.Title FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC'
pred_rows_sample: For Those About To Rock We Salute You

results.question: What is the total amount of all invoices combined?
results.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice;
results.reply: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice
results.model_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice

results.question: What is the total invoice amount for each billing country?
results.gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry;
results.reply: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS TotalAmount FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry
results.model_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS TotalAmount FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

results.question: Which billing country has the highest total invoice amount?
results.gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1;
results.reply: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1
results.model_sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many tracks are there for each media type? Show the media type name and the count.
results.gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId;
results.reply: SELECT MediaType.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM MediaType LEFT JOIN Track ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId GROUP BY MediaType.MediaTypeId, MediaType.Name
results.model_sql: SELECT MediaType.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM MediaType LEFT JOIN Track ON Track.MediaTypeId = MediaType.MediaTypeId GROUP BY MediaType.MediaTypeId, MediaType.Name

results.question: What is the average track length in seconds?
results.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) / 1000.0 FROM Track;
results.reply: SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) / 1000.0 FROM Track
results.model_sql: SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) / 1000.0 FROM Track

results.question: Which employees report directly to Nancy Edwards? Show first and last name.
results.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards';
results.reply: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards'
results.model_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards'

results.question: How many invoices were issued in each year?
results.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), COUNT(*) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1;
results.reply: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS Year, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Invoice GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY Year
results.model_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) AS Year, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Invoice GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY Year

results.question: List the id and name of every playlist that contains no tracks.
results.gold_sql: SELECT PlaylistId, Name FROM Playlist WHERE PlaylistId NOT IN (SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack);
results.reply: SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name FROM Playlist p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlaylistTrack pt WHERE pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId)
results.model_sql: SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name FROM Playlist p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlaylistTrack pt WHERE pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId)

results.question: For each support representative, how many customers do they support? Show first name, last name and the count.
results.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId;
results.reply: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName
results.model_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName

results.question: What is the name of the longest track?
results.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1;
results.reply: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1
results.model_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many different artists have at least one Jazz track?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT al.ArtistId) FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz';
results.reply: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Album.ArtistId) FROM Track JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Jazz'
results.model_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Album.ArtistId) FROM Track JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Jazz'

results.question: What is the total revenue for each genre, computed from invoice lines as unit price times quantity? Show genre name and revenue.
results.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId;
results.reply: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
results.model_sql: SELECT g.Name, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name

results.question: Which customer has spent the most in total? Show first and last name.
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1;
results.reply: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1
results.model_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: List the titles of albums that have more than 20 tracks.
results.gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId GROUP BY al.AlbumId HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;
results.reply: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) > 20
results.model_sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title HAVING COUNT(t.TrackId) > 20

results.question: How many tracks have no composer listed?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL;
results.reply: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL OR TRIM(Composer) = ''
results.model_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NULL OR TRIM(Composer) = ''

results.question: What percentage of tracks are priced at 0.99?
results.gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UnitPrice = 0.99 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM Track;
results.reply: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UnitPrice = 0.99 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS PercentagePricedAt099 FROM Track
results.model_sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UnitPrice = 0.99 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS PercentagePricedAt099 FROM Track
